name: Sharwa Finance pool liquidity double-counted against a margin position

classification.summary: The Sharwa liquidity pool let an LP withdraw shares covering liquidity that had just been lent out to that same actor's freshly opened leveraged long, so after crashing WBTC through Uniswap V3 and closing the position the loss fell entirely on the remaining LPs.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

The PoC's first transaction provides 2.2M flash-loaned USDC, opens a 36.2M WBTC long and then calls pool.withdraw(pool.balanceOf(this)); the second transaction 0x9f8b4841f805ec50cc6632068f759216d85633fbbe34afde86b97bbc41c23ead closes it. Reported loss 146,000 USD. Distinct from the 2026-05 Sharwa row already in this file.
